officialEvidence.network: More than 70 locations and more than 190 public charging points operated by e-regio in its region.
officialEvidence.adhoc: All charging points have QR codes for ad-hoc charging without registration; supported payments include credit card, Apple Pay, Google Pay and PayPal; most fast chargers are being equipped with card terminals.
officialEvidence.pricingPolicy: The currently applicable station prices are shown in the e-regio LadeApp. e-regio explicitly states that prices can be lower at specific stations or times, so published tariff figures are ceilings rather than a guaranteed per-EVSE price.

decision: No operator-wide direct fallback is created. The official source confirms ad-hoc access and explicitly station/time-dependent pricing; exact current EVSE prices must come from the QR/chargecloud surface or another station-level verified source. Defer deeper enumeration until the 591-CPO first pass is complete.
